sensors.name: Build
sensors.description: Next.js production build via OpenNext for Cloudflare Workers. Baseline ~975ms — spikes to 5s+ indicate ingestion/ leaked into app bundle.

sensors.name: Lint & Format (Biome)
sensors.description: Biome lint + format check. Use before any PR. Project uses Biome, NOT ESLint/Prettier.

sensors.name: CI Lint (Biome strict)
sensors.description: Strict Biome CI mode — same gate as GitHub Actions CI. Must pass before merge.

sensors.name: Unit Tests
sensors.description: Vitest unit tests with coverage thresholds. DB tests use testcontainers (real Postgres), never mocks.

sensors.name: RDS Noop Guard
sensors.description: Verifies RDS semantic tokens resolve to non-empty values (catches theme layer collision bug #416).

sensors.name: RDS Primitive Guard
sensors.description: Ensures no forbidden local primitives are imported after RDS consolidation (ADR-038).

sensors.name: WCAG Contrast Check
sensors.description: Checks color token contrast ratios against WCAG AA thresholds for both light and dark themes.
